info.about: Tornado Outbreak is an action-adventure video game developed by Loose Cannon Studios and published by Konami Digital Entertainment for the PlayStation 3, Wii and Xbox 360. The game was announced at the Electronic Entertainment Expo in June 2009.
info.trivia: It was first announced in June 2009 as Zephyr: Rise of the Elementals and renamed Tornado Outbreak a month later.
info.why: Its developer, Loose Cannon Studios, founded by Sucker Punch veterans, went defunct by 2010 without making another game.
